description: This file contains unit tests for the SessionData-related components in the OpenClaw project, including testing session kind detection, token formatting, usage percentage clamping, and session row flag labels.

methods.name: session kind from key detects common kinds
methods.description: Tests detection of session kinds from different key strings.

methods.name: session token stats format K tokens rounds as expected
methods.description: Verifies the formatting of token counts into human-readable strings.

methods.name: session token stats percent used clamps to 100
methods.description: Checks that usage percentage is capped at 100%.

methods.name: session row flag labels include non default flags
methods.description: Ensures session row flags correctly include labels for non-default flags.
